title: ProjectORIGIN Case Production Workflow

steps.name: Case Intake
steps.purpose: Receive a case-production request without inventing a case identity or subject.
actions: Capture the supplied case request and preserve unknown information as unknown.
exit_conditions: The request is sufficiently identified for registration or an explicit blocking condition is recorded.

steps.name: Case Registration and Applicable Baseline Resolution
steps.purpose: Establish a unique case identity and resolve the applicable formal baseline before production.
actions: Check duplication, allocate or confirm Case ID and File Number, and resolve applicable versions.
exit_conditions: A unique case identity and applicable baseline are confirmed without unresolved Source-of-Truth conflict.

steps.name: Research Planning
steps.purpose: Define evidence needs, source priorities, uncertainties, and research tasks for the registered case.
actions: Plan source collection, verification, uncertainty handling, and research task routing.
exit_conditions: Research scope and required tasks are explicit and traceable to the registered case.

steps.name: Source Collection
steps.purpose: Collect sources required by the research plan while preserving source provenance.
actions: Collect primary and secondary sources and preserve provenance and access limitations.
exit_conditions: Required available sources and explicit source gaps are recorded.

steps.name: Source Verification
steps.purpose: Verify source identity, reliability, provenance, and evidentiary classification without fabricating certainty.
actions: Verify source provenance and separate Fact, Testimony, Theory, Unverified Information, and AI Analysis.
exit_conditions: Each material statement has an explicit verification and classification position or remains marked unverified.

steps.name: Research Artifact Production
steps.purpose: Produce the versioned Research artifact from verified sources without silent overwrite.
actions: Create FILE-XXXX_RESEARCH_v<artifact-version>.md and preserve artifact version independently from audit-run identity.
exit_conditions: The Research artifact is complete, version-identified, source-traceable, and ready for independent audit.

steps.name: Research Audit
steps.purpose: Independently audit the Research artifact under the applicable Audit authority.
actions: Audit evidence, classification, completeness, consistency, version, and applicable requirements without editing the target.
exit_conditions: The authoritative Research Audit artifact establishes the applicable routing result.

steps.name: Approved Research Pre-Approval Persistence
steps.purpose: Persist the Research artifact and applicable PASS audit reference before Human Approval without implying downstream completion.
actions: Persist the approved Research identity, version, and audit reference without silent overwrite.
exit_conditions: Approved Research and Audit references are persistently resolvable; no Human Approval, Repository Integration, or Publication is inferred.

steps.name: Master Case File Production
steps.purpose: Produce the versioned Master Case File using only Approved Research as its case-information basis.
actions: Structure Approved Research using the applicable Master requirements without adding unsupported case information.
exit_conditions: The versioned Master artifact is traceable to Approved Research and ready for independent audit.

steps.name: Master Audit
steps.purpose: Independently audit the Master Case File against Approved Research and applicable requirements.
actions: Audit Master fidelity, evidence balance, consistency, structure, and version identity without editing the target.
exit_conditions: The authoritative Master Audit artifact establishes the applicable routing result.

steps.name: Approved Master Pre-Approval Persistence
steps.purpose: Persist the approved Master identity and audit reference without implying Final Human Approval or publication completion.
actions: Persist Approved Master and Audit references with identity and version traceability.
exit_conditions: Approved Master and Audit references are resolvable and no downstream state is inferred.

steps.name: Publication and Image Branch Planning
steps.purpose: Determine applicability and dependencies for distinct FREE, CLASSIFIED, and Image production branches.
actions: Create separate logical branch requirements and dependencies without inferring branch completion from cursor position.
exit_conditions: Each branch has explicit applicability and dependency references.

steps.name: FREE Production
steps.purpose: Produce the FREE publication artifact from Approved Master with standalone meaning and progressive disclosure.
actions: Produce the FREE artifact without adding case information outside Approved Master.
exit_conditions: The FREE artifact is complete and ready for independent audit.

steps.name: FREE Audit
steps.purpose: Independently audit the FREE artifact against Approved Master and applicable publication requirements.
actions: Audit FREE accuracy, standalone meaning, evidence balance, readability, and progressive disclosure.
exit_conditions: The authoritative FREE Audit artifact establishes the applicable routing result.

steps.name: FREE Human Read Review
steps.purpose: Obtain a reader-facing Human review of the exact FREE artifact version without establishing Final Human Approval.
actions: Review reader experience and record an authoritative Human Read Review decision bound to the artifact version.

resume_rule.resume_rule: Resume only when the authoritative review record contains FREE_HUMAN_READ_REVIEW_COMPLETE.

exit_conditions: The applicable Human Read Review record is closed for the exact FREE artifact version.

routes.resume_rule: Resume only when the authoritative review record contains FREE_HUMAN_READ_REVIEW_COMPLETE.

steps.name: CLASSIFIED Production
steps.purpose: Produce the CLASSIFIED publication artifact from Approved Master with the applicable detailed evidence and analysis.
actions: Produce the CLASSIFIED artifact without adding unsupported case information.
exit_conditions: The CLASSIFIED artifact is complete and ready for independent audit.

steps.name: CLASSIFIED Audit
steps.purpose: Independently audit the CLASSIFIED artifact against Approved Master and applicable publication requirements.
actions: Audit CLASSIFIED accuracy, evidence depth, uncertainty, counterarguments, readability, and Master fidelity.
exit_conditions: The authoritative CLASSIFIED Audit artifact establishes the applicable routing result.

steps.name: CLASSIFIED Human Read Review
steps.purpose: Obtain a reader-facing Human review of the exact CLASSIFIED artifact version without establishing Final Human Approval.
actions: Review reader experience and record an authoritative Human Read Review decision bound to the artifact version.

resume_rule.resume_rule: Resume only when the authoritative review record contains CLASSIFIED_HUMAN_READ_REVIEW_COMPLETE.

exit_conditions: The applicable Human Read Review record is closed for the exact CLASSIFIED artifact version.

routes.resume_rule: Resume only when the authoritative review record contains CLASSIFIED_HUMAN_READ_REVIEW_COMPLETE.

steps.name: Image Requirement Management
steps.purpose: Create and manage Case-unique Image Requirements independently from Approved Image Asset identity.
actions: Record Requirement IDs, reader purposes, routes, dependencies, and completion conditions in the Image Requirement Register.
exit_conditions: Every applicable image need has a distinct Requirement ID, route, dependency, and completion condition; Requirement ID is not Asset ID.

steps.name: Image Candidate Collection and Authorized Production
steps.purpose: Collect or produce image candidates only through routes authorized by the applicable Image Requirement and Governance.
actions: Collect source candidates or produce authorized visualizations while preserving classification and provenance.
exit_conditions: Candidate identity, source route, and applicable Rights-verification need are explicit.

steps.name: Rights Inquiry and Verification Lifecycle
steps.purpose: Determine and verify source and Rights conditions through distinct AI, Human, and External Wait responsibilities.
actions: Execute RIGHTS-01 through RIGHTS-10 without treating draft, dispatch, response, extraction, verification, or approval as equivalent states.
exit_conditions: An authoritative Rights determination supports Continue, Stop, or Alternative Source routing without implying Human Approval.

substates.name: Rights Determination
substates.purpose: Determine whether additional Rights verification is required.
exit_conditions: Rights-verification requirements and unknowns are explicit.

substates.name: Institution / Contact Verification
substates.purpose: Verify the institution or contact without treating contactability as permission.
exit_conditions: A contact candidate is verified or the absence remains explicit.

substates.name: Inquiry Draft Preparation
substates.purpose: Prepare an inquiry draft without representing it as sent.
exit_conditions: A reviewable draft exists and remains distinct from dispatch evidence.

substates.name: Human Send Gate
substates.purpose: Require Human-controlled dispatch and applicable dispatch evidence before external wait begins.
exit_conditions: HUMAN_SEND_CONFIRMED is recorded and applicable dispatch evidence is referenced.

resume_rule.resume_rule: Resume within CPW-021 toward RIGHTS-05 only after HUMAN_SEND_CONFIRMED and applicable dispatch evidence is referenced.

substates.name: External Wait
substates.purpose: Wait resumably for an external response without interpreting silence or timeout.
exit_conditions: An external response is captured or an authorized fallback route becomes applicable.

substates.name: Response Evidence Capture
substates.purpose: Capture the external response as evidence without equating response with permission.
exit_conditions: Response evidence is preserved with identity and provenance.

substates.name: AI-Assisted Factual Extraction
substates.purpose: Extract factual conditions without creating Human consent or binding interpretation.
exit_conditions: Extracted facts remain traceable to response evidence and are not treated as consent.

substates.name: Human Ambiguous / Binding Interpretation
substates.purpose: Require Human interpretation for ambiguous or binding Rights terms.
exit_conditions: An authoritative Human interpretation exists where required.

resume_rule.resume_rule: Resume within CPW-021 toward RIGHTS-09 only from the authoritative HUMAN_RIGHTS_INTERPRETATION_RECORDED record; it does not establish permission or Rights Verification.

substates.name: Rights Verification Decision
substates.purpose: Establish the applicable Rights decision without establishing Final Human Approval.
exit_conditions: The Rights decision is evidence-bound and does not imply Human Approval.

substates.name: Continue / Stop / Alternative Source
substates.purpose: Route the candidate from the authoritative Rights decision.
exit_conditions: Continue, Stop, or Alternative Source routing is explicit.

steps.name: Image Classification, Metadata and Caption Preparation
steps.purpose: Prepare image classification, metadata, caption, credits, and Rights references without changing case information.
actions: Classify the image and prepare required metadata, caption, credits, and evidence references.
exit_conditions: The exact candidate has complete applicable classification, metadata, caption, credits, and Rights references.

steps.name: Conditional Human Visual Review
steps.purpose: Perform Human Visual Review only when required by the applicable authority and bind it to the exact candidate identity.
actions: Determine applicability and, when required, obtain a Human Visual Review bound to the exact candidate identity or SHA-256.

resume_rule.resume_rule: Resume from the authoritative HUMAN_VISUAL_REVIEW_COMPLETE record when the gate is applicable.

exit_conditions: Applicable Human Visual Review is closed, or an authority-backed determination records it as not applicable.

routes.resume_rule: Resume from the authoritative HUMAN_VISUAL_REVIEW_COMPLETE record when applicable.

steps.name: Formal Image Audit
steps.purpose: Independently audit the exact image candidate package under the applicable Image and Audit authorities.
actions: Audit source, Rights, classification, integrity, caption, metadata, and applicable Human Visual Review binding without editing the candidate.
exit_conditions: The authoritative Image Audit artifact establishes the applicable routing result.

steps.name: Approved Image Asset Registration and Validation
steps.purpose: Register an Image Audit PASS candidate as an Approved Image Asset after mandatory mechanical validation and any applicable conditional formal verification audit.
actions: Perform mandatory mechanical validation of registration artifacts, identity, version, checksum, and sidecar consistency.
Perform an independent Formal Registration Verification Audit only when an applicable risk trigger exists.
Register the Approved Image Asset without implying Human Approval, Publication Artifact Repository Integration, or Publication.

re_audit_trigger: Applicable risk trigger under Audit Rule or Image Rule

exit_conditions: Mandatory mechanical validation passes and any applicable conditional Formal Registration Verification Audit is closed.

steps.name: Placement Transaction and Change Impact Handling
steps.purpose: Bind an Approved Image Asset identity to an exact publication artifact placement and close applicable downstream impacts.
actions: Bind Asset ID, Asset Version, and SHA-256 to target artifact identity, artifact version, section, and slot; assess each possible downstream impact independently.
exit_conditions: Placement identity is complete and all applicable audit, review, placement, and package impacts are closed without global automatic invalidation.

steps.name: Final Flow Validation and Human Review Package
steps.purpose: Validate end-to-end applicable branch readiness and produce a version-bound, immutable, reference-only Human Review Package.
actions: Validate authoritative references for every applicable branch and create or validate the immutable Human Review Package snapshot.
exit_conditions: Final Flow Audit routing is established and the exact version-bound Human Review Package references resolve; package existence does not establish READY, Human Approval, Repository Integration, or Publication.

steps.name: Final Human Approval
steps.purpose: Obtain the authoritative final Human Approval Decision for the exact applicable publication artifacts and versions.
actions: Present the exact version-bound review package and record the Human Approval Decision without inferring publication completion.

resume_rule.resume_rule: Resume only from the authoritative applicable APPROVED decision bound to the exact artifacts and versions.

exit_conditions: An authoritative applicable Human Approval Decision is recorded for the exact artifacts and versions.

routes.resume_rule: Only an authoritative applicable APPROVED decision may enter CPW-029.

steps.name: Repository Integration and Publication Lifecycle
steps.purpose: Execute post-approval Repository Integration and Publication responsibilities as five distinct evidence-bound substates.
actions: Execute DELIVERY-01 through DELIVERY-05 without collapsing integration, execution, evidence, status, or tracking.
exit_conditions: All applicable delivery substates are independently evidenced and traceable without cross-inference.

substates.name: Publication Artifact Repository Integration
substates.purpose: Integrate the exact Human-approved publication artifacts into the formal Repository without establishing Publication.
exit_conditions: Repository Integration evidence exists for the exact approved artifacts and versions.

substates.name: Publication Execution
substates.purpose: Execute the applicable Publication process without treating an execution response as completion evidence.
exit_conditions: Publication execution has completed sufficiently to proceed to independent evidence capture.

substates.name: Publication Completion Evidence Capture
substates.purpose: Capture authoritative completion evidence independently from Publication Status.
exit_conditions: Publication completion evidence is captured and bound to the exact published artifacts.

substates.name: Publication Status Establishment
substates.purpose: Establish Publication Status under Repository Rule authority from applicable evidence, not automatically from execution or tracking.
exit_conditions: Publication Status is established by its authoritative source under the applicable Repository Rule.

substates.name: publication-tracking update
substates.purpose: Update artifact-level publication tracking without treating tracking as evidence or Publication Status.
exit_conditions: Tracking references are updated without becoming Publication evidence or Publication Status.

orchestration_manifest.responsibility_boundary: The manifest_version is v1.0. The Manifest is a non-authoritative runtime cursor and reference aggregator; it cannot establish or replace domain results.

image_requirement_register.responsibility_boundary: Requirement ID is not Asset ID. The interface does not duplicate Rights Evidence, Image Audit Result, Human Approval, or Publication Status.

required_fields: open issue or HOLD references when applicable
human_review_package.responsibility_boundary: The package is a version-bound immutable reference-only snapshot. Its existence does not establish READY, Human Approval, Repository Integration, or Publication.

notes: This operational Workflow Definition is non-authoritative and does not replace Official Governance.
The lifecycle mechanism defines PROPOSED and ADOPTED; this definition remains PROPOSED and Formal Adoption has not been performed.
Execution-controller states are not Case Workflow Status, Audit Result, Rights Result, Human Review Result, Human Approval Decision, Repository Integration Result, or Publication Status.
Exact identity-set, ordering, reachability, routing-semantic, and authority-content validation remains assigned to later validators.
